verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's structured output_type forces model responses to match a Pydantic schema (validation/transformation of output) and deferred-tools require human approval before execution (a form of input gating), which can be leveraged as guardrail-like mechanisms, but there is no dedicated 'guardrails' API for blocking unsafe/harmful content. missing for 10: explicit safety/content-moderation guardrail feature, dedicated input/output safety validators, and any evidence of blocking unsafe content specifically.
